steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Señor... Ulpianus?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Phew... So it is you, okay.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: We met once, at Gran Faro, actually it was you who approached me... Though I never learned your name until after I got here.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Please, you're not supposed to be here, it's—

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Control center for the beacon tower.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: That man on the floor... did you do that?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: It's the most fitting end for one who fell.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: What did he do?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: None of your business, young one. Leave this place, for your own safety.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The nest beacons have all been activated. The sabotaged weapons are warming up. How else can I warn the Hunters...?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Is Laurentina's group in danger?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Did this man do it? Is that why you...?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: You won't tell me. You don't trust me... Well, I don't trust you either, honestly. You never introduce yourself, and seeing all this, it's really only right to suspect you.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: But they're your friends. You're a Hunter, too. I think I know a little about your tales together.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: He did his dirty work on them before they left.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: They're still caught in the Seaborn tide for now. I'm not entirely certain what's going to happen, but the danger is definite.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: If they went to plant the beacon and are still in the nest, maybe we could send their beacon a signal from this tower, to warn them.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I was helping out here earlier. I know roughly how the basic controls work.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: ...Then do it.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: O-Okay.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Well?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: It's much more complex in practice, but I can say this tower seems to operate on a very similar framework to a lighthouse's control system.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: As far as I'm aware, Breogan passed through this city and aided the tower reconstruction effort.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: The technician mentioned that the tower will automatically navigate the weapons once every beacon is active, and all other controls will be locked out by the program.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: So if we want to send a signal to one of these beacons—let me see...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Just as I feared, it's impossible to resume control.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Do you have any way to circumvent the lockdown?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: If Breogan was involved in the reconstruction, then maybe, just maybe... I have a very stupid plan.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: My entire time here in Milliarium, I've been trying to get to understand the man Breogan was.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: He had a habit of writing things down. Always noting his thoughts, his suspicions, etc. He kept it up even on dry land.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Was it so he wouldn't forget things? I think... I can try temporarily shutting down the main control panel's data decomposition system, like this—

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Um, before, you were bringing up... my history...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: You called me Breogan's descendant, but just from looking at his images, you can tell I don't resemble the genius architect one bit.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: My parents were just Ægirs 'rooted' to the land. There are plenty of us across Iberia and the other terrestrial countries. Strictly speaking, we don't even count as...

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: So what?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: It... it used to trouble me, but recently I've been learning to let myself get over it, to not think so hard about it.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: It's just, you were the first to ever mention that to me, so I wanted to be sure. Um, why did you think I was...

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: True, I did miss the mark, but I never engage in baseless speculation.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: There is more of a bond between you than you think.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: A bond?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The Profound Silence ruined Iberia. The lighthouses fell dark along the coast, and doubt and suspicion grew in their shadow.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Breogan was forced to flee the splendor he himself had designed. Gran Faro was one place he sheltered while on the run. The research notes your parents left you are undoubtedly connected to him.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: They were people he knew he could entrust his life's work to.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Look at what you're doing now, young one. You may not be his descendant by blood, but you have most certainly inherited a portion of his wisdom.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Milliarium is the first Ægirian city you visited and, coincidentally, the last Breogan stopped at before leaving the country entirely.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: His trail covers the entire seabed, and everywhere he went he visited those of great repute to share his thoughts on dry land, his conjectures on Terra's future.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: He had hoped someone would head for the continent with him, so that one day land and sea might stand against crisis together, seek new possibilities together.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Many admired him for his talent, but perhaps his suggestions were too ahead of his time, for in the end hardly any responded to his invitation.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: In Milliarium, he even volunteered to take part in this tower's reconstruction, in exchange for an audience with the then consul.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: And?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Do you need to ask? He was rejected.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: But as the work finished, he made the final decision to wrap up his winding tour and officially depart for the faraway soils.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Even if his time on the road had gained him practically no support.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Think over what you've done. You left the town you knew, and came to this alien place they call your home. That, too, took incredible courage.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: In this respect, you and Breogan are not dissimilar. Conversely, if all you'd shared was just blood, then that would have been something to be ashamed of.

spans.text: In this respect, you and Breogan are not dissimilar. Conversely, if all you'd shared was just blood, then
would have been something to be ashamed of.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: I do not usually play psychological counselor, Jordi Fontanarossa.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I think, really, I...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Ah.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: That did it. At the very least, signaling a single beacon shouldn't be an issue—let's see, Nest 37...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I hope Laurentina and her friends notice.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Actually, Señor Ulpianus.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Is it just me, or is the air getting... stuffy?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: My comms just picked up a faint gravitational wave. What a strange feeling, seeing the ripples in spacetime with my own eyes.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Just like in the manual. Seems the beacon's already active.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: According to Clementia, this beacon going live should mean the Class IV weapon array will automatically come online.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We should head back the way we came, immediately.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Aw, and here I was thinking we'd stay behind and enjoy our front-row seats!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: What's so fun about watching cannons fire?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Oh? Weren't we supposed to have something rather different in store?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: I thought we'd see the Seaborn silently 'popping' all at once across the entire stretch. How poetic, how fitting, when you consider all the little bastards' wrongs, no?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Though Class IV weaponry may not affect us, pointless dithering will only invite more variables.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Hrmph, fine. Off we go, then.
(Vacuole merrily whirls)
A soft murmur reaches Specter's ear, and when she turns to look, she meets with an eye. More accurately, a 'nucleus' leaping to and fro.
The flagella of the Seaborn sticks to her cheek, soft as a kiss. Specter sees the nucleus pulsing in a clear rhythm, blending with her own heartbeat.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Shark!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Don't attack yet, Skadi.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: It went straight past us?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Doesn't strike me that we spooked it. More like something pulled it away.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The beacon!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Captain?

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The gravitational waves coming from this thing aren't supposed to be so irregular, are they?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Skadi, behind you!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Move!

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Vacuole merrily whirls)

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Soft membrane cheerily stirs)

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Creased skin excitedly shudders)
The currents reverse.
The tide sweeping the Seaborn surges back into the nest. The sound of beating membranous wings, of compressing and unfolding, of clamoring mouthparts, of roaring streams...
The whole space reverberates with layer upon layer of cries—of pure elation!

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The beacon's been completely drowned out.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: The eggs and newborns are multiplying rapidly!

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Clementia said all formless newborns would enter straight into necrosis, and the mature individuals would flee from the area.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: While the fungal mat, the vegetation... the whole nest would decay, starting from the environment.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: But clearly we're not seeing much of a 'collective necrosis' here, are we?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: If anything, I'd say they're full of life!

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Pull back!
Gladiia turns the instant she barks the order, her lance piercing the Seaborn ahead as ruptured tissues bursts about like blood.

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Ever since that little bastard touched my face, I've been feeling sleepy, somehow...

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: How very strange. It's been so long since I felt this way...

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Ugh, I thought it was just me.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: This shouldn't be...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Combat only sharpens an Abyssal Hunter's lucidity.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Blandus?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: You mean the auto-adaptive junction surgery?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: We discovered an anomaly, and Blandus certainly treated us, but he also tampered with the procedure.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Yet whether coincidence or not, the Church's attack cleared our suspicions of him.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: ...This was my mistake.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: But, he's the Advisor. Why would he?

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: If we want answers, we must make it back to the city.
Specter skips ahead at the vanguard, her dance as graceful as ever. With but a twirl, a high-RPM sawblade leaves the Seaborn ahead carved in two.

steps.name: Seaborn
steps.text: (Vacuole excitedly swells)

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: The beasts have noticed us, and yet show hardly any will to attack.

steps.name: Skadi
steps.text: Captain, Shark, have you noticed the water flowing... slower?

steps.name: Specter
steps.text: Get a hold of yourself, Skadi.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: No, wait. She's right.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: These animals are secreting something.
Finally, the tide receding, the nest temporarily bares the truth of its transformation.
Seaborn living and dead fall into every ravine in the seabed. The nest's borders have begun to bleach, chitin coming together into a thick crust.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Something has provided them immense nutrition. The whole nest is forming a carapace, and spurring every life within to evolve faster.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: A 'shell.' If we take the Iberian's so-called 'nethersea brand' as the roadmap for the organisms' expansion, then this shell is the final act of fuelling before it begins.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Without warning, the beacon pulsed irregular gravitational waves. Right afterward, the Seaborn swarm began to nest around it...

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Either this is some elusive aberration in the weapons themselves, or someone in the city is trying to remotely control the beacon to transmit information. Or possibly both.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Whatever Blandus did to us during surgery has dulled our senses.

steps.name: Gladiia
steps.text: Consider the hunt on! Time is of the essence! Get out of here!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: *pant*, *cough*—

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Your cheeks are flushed, and your clothes soaked through with sweat.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: I-I'm not nervous!

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: You're accustomed to dry, arid land. You're more sensitive to dampness than an average Ægir.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: The humidity is wracking you.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Hold on...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Look, look at the chart!

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Densely packed bio-signatures... from—from right above us?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: It's the dome above the tower... The Seaborn are seeping into the city through there.

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: No, but weren't there two Legions out there keeping them at bay? Plus the Hunters...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Even, even if some from other nests slipped around the perimeter, Milliarium still has countless sensor units across the dome, and all sorts of complex defenses...

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: How could the Seaborn get into the city without a sound?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: Did this tower draw them in?

steps.name: Jordi
steps.text: *cough* *cough*, *pant*—But why?

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: My guess is, someone showed them the path.

steps.name: Ulpianus
steps.text: Blandus, had it ever dawned on you that your folly would lead to such disaster?
Ulpianus is pensive.

He does not turn to look at the culprit of all this, lying motionless on the floor. He stares closely at the holographic sea chart. Dots representing the Seaborn swarm converge right on Milliarium's coordinates.
They shine like the stars.
